name: Atelier Zero
summary: A magazine-grade, collage-driven visual system: warm paper canvas, surreal plaster-and-architecture imagery, oversized display type, hairline rules, Roman-numeral section markers, and tiny editorial annotations.
use_when: Studio or agency site that wants a printed, magazine-like feel

name: Brutalism
summary: Raw, anti-design aesthetic inspired by concrete architecture with unadorned elements, jarring layouts, and functional minimalism.
use_when: Loud, heavy, high-contrast brand or event page

name: Corporate
summary: Professional, brand-aligned design with structured grids, minimalist layouts, and consistent enterprise patterns.
use_when: Business app that must look trustworthy and conventional

name: Dashboard
summary: Dark-themed cloud-platform aesthetic with modular grids, glass-like panels, and strong data hierarchy for productivity dashboards.
use_when: Light KPI dashboard with cards, charts and tables

name: Neutral Modern
summary: A clean, product-oriented default. Use when the brief doesn't call for a specific mood — good for B2B tools, dashboards, and utility pages.
use_when: Safe neutral fallback when no stronger direction exists

name: Editorial
summary: Magazine-inspired editorial layout with refined serif typography, structured grids, and elegant reading experiences.
use_when: Long-form content, blog or publication home with serif headings

name: Enterprise
summary: Clean, high-contrast enterprise design for data-driven workflows with intuitive drag-and-drop patterns and structured layouts.
use_when: Dense admin and back-office screens, many tables and forms

name: HUD Design System
summary: Fighter jet / helicopter head-up display. Phosphor green on near-black, all-caps data overlays, angular geometry. Zero ambiguity at speed and altitude.
use_when: Telemetry or sci-fi HUD with monospace labels

name: Minimal
summary: Stripped-back design emphasizing whitespace, clean typography, and restrained color for maximum clarity and focus.
use_when: Neutral type-led product page or settings-heavy app

name: Mission Control Design System
summary: Space/aerospace mission monitoring. Dark command center, amber telemetry, monospace precision. Functional clarity above all else.
use_when: Ops or developer console; dark with status colors

name: Mono
summary: Monospace-driven, matrix-inspired design with high-contrast elements, compact density, and a hacker-chic aesthetic.

name: Paper
summary: Paper-textured, print-inspired design with minimal colors, clean serif/sans typography, and tactile surface qualities.
use_when: Nostalgic paper-and-ink look for notes, journals, reading apps

name: Trading Terminal Design System
summary: Bloomberg-style financial trading terminal. Dark-only, data-dense, cyan/coral buy/sell signals. Everything readable at a glance from two meters away.
use_when: Dense live numbers, order books, tickers; tabular figures matter

name: Warm Editorial
summary: A serif-led magazine aesthetic. Terracotta accent on warm off-white paper — good for long-form, editorial, and brand-led marketing pages.
use_when: Warm, friendly editorial look for a service business
